name: Hayward Police Department Summer Youth Academy
what_you_do: A one-week summer class about how the Hayward Police Department works. Topics include patrol, forensics, and SWAT and K9 demos.
who_can_apply: The current page does not state ages or grades. The 2023 city notice said students entering grades 8 to 12.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the page.
duration: One week, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. daily (2026: July 6 to 10).
deadline_text: The 2026 academy ran July 6 to 10, 2026. The page gave no closing date. In 2023, applications were due June 29. Expect the 2027 application in late spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the Youth Academy page. Your spot is not confirmed until staff contact you and send a confirmation email. Class size is limited. Questions: (510) 293-1043.
notes: The 2026 class met at Fire Station 6 Training Center, 1401 W. Winton Ave. The page warns the course may include simulated firearms and graphic subject matter. The 2026 application link (research.net/r/HPDYA-2026) is for last year, so wait for the 2027 link.
